themes.quote: We continue to grow our wealth and investment management business, with strong momentum in assets under management and advisory services
We are actively managing our commercial real estate exposure through disciplined underwriting and portfolio management
We remain focused on growing customer relationships and deepening engagement across our consumer and commercial segments
We are investing in digital and technology capabilities to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency
We continue to monitor credit quality across all segments with disciplined risk management practices
We continue to focus on growing relationships and deposits through our consumer and commercial franchises
Commercial real estate risks remain elevated given higher interest rate environment and refinancing pressures
We maintain strong capital levels and continue share repurchases and dividend payments
Net interest margin benefited from deposit mix improvement and higher yielding loan originations
We are actively monitoring credit quality across our portfolios given economic uncertainties and elevated delinquencies
Commercial real estate continues to face headwinds with higher interest rates and slower economic activity impacting property valuations and borrower credit quality
We continue to face intense competition for deposits, which is pressuring deposit margins and funding costs across the industry
We are focused on optimizing our mortgage banking business through selective originations and enhanced servicing capabilities
Capital markets revenue increased significantly, reflecting strong client activity in advisory, underwriting, and trading services
Credit quality is normalizing from historically low levels as economic conditions moderate, with increases in nonperforming assets and charge-offs
